verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's own data inside the Workers product. Workers AI, AI Search, and the Agents SDK are developer building blocks for building AI features into apps. The Observability MCP server lets an external agent query account data, which is not an in-product insight feature. The built-in observability claim offers "visibility and insight" but nothing indicates it is AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
